standard.maturity: stable package; native beta acceptance still required
standard.authority: NinjaTrader native execution, risk truth, replication, protection, persistence, journal, and UI

advanced.authority: Hermes owns probabilistic judgment and intent; Glitch owns factual executability, native mutation, protection, reconciliation, and receipts

topstep.authority: separate ProjectX product and release rail; no NinjaTrader evidence is inherited

constitution.intent: Glitch never creates a trade without manual master execution or authenticated Hermes/user intent and never mutates that intent into a hidden strategy.
constitution.replication: When enabled, copy exact attributable native execution deltas at the configured ratio; configuration changes alone do not create catch-up trades; explicit Sync owns catch-up.
constitution.risk: Deterministic blocking is limited to factual execution invalidity, authoritative hard account/venue boundaries, unprovable ownership/protection, duplicate/ambiguous mutation, explicit operator disablement, or granular user opt-in compliance.
constitution.evidence: Queue admission, source shape, package publication, screenshots, or short-session profit are not native terminal correctness.

history.note: The detailed replication, UI, persistence, analytics, compliance, control, audit, and historical rail remains immutable in Git history. This ledger is the smaller active beta authority.
